title: Critique: infants feel pain but likely lack higher-order thoughts

statements.text: Frontal activity is low in newborns and endogenous attention matures late, so infants likely lack higher-order thoughts, yet there is no reason to think their pain is less intense than adult pain. Calling such pains unconscious makes the claim trivial.

sources.quote: low frontal activity in newborns may well indicate lack of higher-order thoughts about genuine sensory experiences
Evidence against both higher-order thought and unconscious states puts Rosenthal in a vise
